note: Approved decorative or brand SVG exceptions only; functional icons must use lucide-react. Raw colors are a shrinking legacy ceiling, not permission for new values. SaZones.tsx holds the zone polygon canvas: it is a data graphic the SA edits, not an icon, and it stays on a schematic 0..100 grid so no external map tile is needed. DonutChart.tsx holds the Ringkasan donut: arcs need SVG stroke-dasharray, and it is a data graphic, not an icon; bars in the same dashboard are plain HTML/CSS. Sparkline.tsx holds the merchant revenue sparkline: a line needs a polyline path, which HTML/CSS cannot draw, and it is a data graphic with an aria-label carrying the numbers, not an icon.
